theorems.name: Trace and curve order
theorems.exact_statement: For an elliptic curve E over F_Q with Frobenius trace t, #E(F_Q)=Q+1-t and |t|<=2 sqrt(Q).
theorems.hypotheses: E is nonsingular and defined over the finite field F_Q.
theorems.open_bridge: Formal finite-field elliptic curve, Frobenius, point count and Hasse bound.

theorems.name: Trace-one anomalous criterion
theorems.exact_statement: For E/F_p, #E(F_p)=p if and only if t=1. The published p-adic reduction applies under its specified lifting hypotheses.
theorems.hypotheses: p prime, E/F_p nonsingular; the reduction's lifting and subgroup hypotheses are additional.
theorems.open_bridge: Formal p-adic lift and Smart reduction; the trace equivalence alone does not formalize the reduction.

theorems.name: Prime-power decomposition of a selected cyclic group
theorems.exact_statement: If a selected cyclic group has certified order r=product_i l_i^e_i with pairwise coprime factors, its DLP reduces to the corresponding prime-power DLPs and CRT recombination.
theorems.hypotheses: The selected group is cyclic, its order and factorization are certified, and the target belongs to it.
theorems.open_bridge: Formal cyclic-group DLP equivalence and CRT reconstruction with a chosen generator.

theorems.name: Pairing transfer criterion
theorems.exact_statement: For a suitable nondegenerate pairing on the selected prime-order r-subgroup, the ECDLP maps to a multiplicative DLP in the minimal field containing the relevant r-th roots of unity.
theorems.hypotheses: r is prime to the characteristic; the pairing and auxiliary point satisfy the published nondegeneracy and subgroup hypotheses.
theorems.open_bridge: Formal Weil/Tate pairing, its nondegeneracy and the explicit injective subgroup map.

theorems.name: Cubic Hilbert-90 forward identity
theorems.exact_statement: Let L/K be a cyclic cubic field extension with generator sigma and alpha in L^x. If lambda=sigma(alpha)/alpha, then lambda sigma(lambda) sigma^2(lambda)=1. For finite K=F_q, this is lambda^(q^2+q+1)=1.
theorems.hypotheses: L/K cyclic of degree three; alpha nonzero; the finite-field exponent corollary uses sigma(x)=x^q.
theorems.open_bridge: The Lean declarations prove the automorphism norm identity and q-power consequence under explicit sigma(x)=x^q and sigma^3(alpha)=alpha hypotheses. Instantiating the exact finite-field tower and the Hilbert-90 converse remain separate obligations.

theorems.name: Fourth power in the odd cubic torus
theorems.exact_statement: Let G be a monoid, p an odd natural number and q=p^2. If x in G satisfies x^(q^2+q+1)=1, then x=y^4 for y=x^((q^2+q+2)/4).
theorems.hypotheses: p is odd; the exact torus exponent equation holds in G. The genus-three and finite-field instantiations are separate results.

theorems.name: Cubic branch conductor-depth obstruction
theorems.exact_statement: For the stated p>3 cubic norm-one genus-three branch over F_(p^6), ordinary Frobenius classes supporting a branch representative have v_2(f_pi)>=2 for both allowed twist signs.
theorems.hypotheses: The exact branch model, nonsingularity, ordinary trace, allowed twists, rational 2-isogeny and endomorphism-order hypotheses in the ISO-1 report.
theorems.open_bridge: Full elliptic-curve torsion, isogeny, endomorphism-order and twist-descent formalization; parent PR #1710 proves several structural prerequisites only.

theorems.name: Exact two-branch class support on the declared ordinary domain
theorems.exact_statement: Within the p>3, degree-six, t congruent 2 mod 4 ordinary domain and the stated CM exceptions, each hyperelliptic branch has the exact torus/selected-order intersection criterion recorded by ISO-1.
theorems.hypotheses: The exact two branch models, D_K<-4 in the generic criterion, exceptional-unit handling in the finite oracle, and certified CM support inputs.
theorems.open_bridge: Full CM order realizability and elliptic isogeny-class geometry; branch labels come from independently checked native/PARI certificates.

theorems.name: Two-branch finite inclusion-exclusion
theorems.exact_statement: For any finite list of two Boolean branch flags, cubic_count+quadratic_count=union_count+both_count, and union_count+zero_count=population_count.
theorems.hypotheses: A finite list of Boolean flags; repeated rows count repeatedly.
theorems.open_bridge: This establishes aggregation semantics only; it does not certify imported geometric labels.

theorems.name: Dimension guard for full Weil restriction transfer
theorems.exact_statement: If an abelian variety of dimension g admits a surjective homomorphism onto Res_(F_(q^n)/F_q)(E), then g>=n.
theorems.hypotheses: E is an elliptic curve over F_(q^n); the map is a surjective homomorphism of abelian varieties over F_q.
theorems.open_bridge: Formal Weil restriction as an abelian variety and dimension monotonicity of surjective morphisms.
